_meta.description: GET /api/vehicles/{vehicleId}/snapshot (rest-api.md §7.1) for a car whose owner has PAUSED ride sharing (MYR-342, contracts 0.20.0). Everything about the car itself is healthy — parked, charged, streaming, NOT in service — which is exactly the state no pre-MYR-342 field could express. The pause lives in rideShareEnabled alone, and it is the SAME value and the same semantics as the VehicleSummary sibling on the list row (see vehicles_list_ride_share.json). The parked snapshot.json every other test uses deliberately OMITS the key, which is what keeps 'absent means enabled' observable rather than asserted in prose.
